tests.reason: KNOWN GAP: POST memberships is SELECT-then-INSERT with no lock and UNIQUE(user_sub, org_id, role) omits the role-free key, so concurrent adds create two roles (12/12 trials)
KNOWN GAP: POST memberships accepts any user_sub with no existence/format check; the outbox then silently drops the rejected tuple
KNOWN GAP: outbox marks events processed even when OpenFGA rejects the tuple (any HTTP 400 is treated as 'already exists')
KNOWN GAP: realm registers the wildcard http://localhost:3000/*, so any path on the app origin is an accepted callback (requirement: exact match)
KNOWN GAP: gateway verifies the signature only; it never checks aud/azp, so a token minted for ANY client in the realm is accepted
KNOWN GAP: the org-scoped cutoff is enforced only by requirePermission routes; course reads and /overview ignore it
KNOWN GAP: GET /api/courses/:id never calls recordAudit, so course reads (the most common decision) leave no audit row
KNOWN GAP: AGENT_SECRET falls back to a hard-coded default and the delegator claim is trusted from the token, so anyone who knows the default can act as any user
KNOWN GAP: POST /api/agents/delegate does not check that the caller belongs to the org it delegates
KNOWN GAP: delegation duration is unbounded
KNOWN GAP: delegation scopes are not validated against an allow-list
